properties.notes: Redevelopment of car park to provide a four to eight storey building comprising 242sqm of workshop/commercial/community (Class A2/A3/B1/D1) space on the ground floor and 33 residential apartments (Class C3) on the upper floors; amenity areas; landscaping with associated surface parking; bin and cycle storage; substation; re-location of vehicle access on Vaughan Road; and alterations to adjacent highway.
